cand.title: XXV ISPRS Congress 2026 Toronto
cand.organizationName: International Society for Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
cand.excerpt: International congress with an official housing bureau, contracted room obligations, delegate hotel inventory and 10+ rooms-per-night group-booking threshold; directly supports lodging, meeting, exhibitor and event-service demand across Toronto.
cand.selectionWhy: Prior blocked-promising candidate (no exact date/contact in thin ledger)

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Derek Lichti, 2026 Congress Director, is the strongest named historical organizer relationship contact; the official contact page publishes ddlichti@ucalgary.ca. Ahmed Shaker was listed as Deputy Director/CRSS-SCT President on the 2026 committee page; the post-event host report identifies his election as ISPRS Secretary General. He is relevant for association routing and future Canadian relationships, not a verified hotel-contract signatory. Petra Helmholz is officially named Sydney 2029 Congress Director, relevant only to the overseas next edition. ICS is the verified operational housing route, but no named individual ICS housing buyer was established. None of these roles proves hotel purchasing or signing authority.
findings.futureEdition: Toronto 2026 is past. The next officially announced Congress is XXVI ISPRS Congress, Sydney, Australia, in 2029, outside the requested horizon. No exact 2029 start/end dates were found on the official announcement or event site; therefore no fully dated next edition can be reported. The Sydney site identifies ICC Sydney as its venue, while describing the room configuration as proposed; this is not evidence of an executed venue contract. The following Congress is Incheon, Republic of Korea, 29 June–6 July 2030. No Toronto return is announced in these sources.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using supplied hotel specifications: the 157-room Harbourfront hotel is geographically appropriate for a downtown MTCC event, but cannot be exclusive housing or the primary plenary venue for a Congress that actually drew 2,084 participants. Plausible roles for a future Toronto-related programme would be a limited delegate/speaker or executive block, small side meetings, or a reception within the supplied room capacities. No such block or function is evidenced for Radisson Blu. This is city-hotel rather than resort demand. Do not promise catering or restaurant/lounge service before operational verification; the supplied product caveat remains unresolved.
findings.venueCommitments: Historical Toronto venue: Metro Toronto Convention Centre, entire South Building, 222 Bremner Boulevard, Toronto, Ontario M5V 3L9, Canada. This is downtown Toronto proper, within the MTCC territory, not a suburban venue or hotel. The edition-specific site states the Congress would occupy the entire South Building. This historical commitment does not establish future availability. Sydney 2029 names International Convention Centre Sydney, Sydney, New South Wales, Australia; contract execution is not published.
findings.historicalRotation: Official history records 2012 Melbourne; 2016 Prague; 2020/2021/2022 Nice; 2026 Toronto. The Nice Congress spanned virtual editions in 2020 and 2021 and an in-person edition in 2022, not three normal annual destination rotations. ISPRS announced annual Congresses beginning in 2029, replacing its former quadrennial Congress/midterm symposia/Geospatial Week structure. This is verified series recurrence, not annual Toronto recurrence.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Historical edition-specific housing was managed by International Conference Services Ltd. (ICS), the official housing bureau/Housing Secretariat. Exact source wording: "Contracted room obligations cannot be met if registrants reserve rooms outside the official hotel or book hotels through channels other than the official Housing Secretariat." It warns of attrition fees and says delegates must register before booking. Every listed accommodation: Delta Hotels Toronto; DoubleTree by Hilton Toronto Downtown; The George – Residence & Conference Centre – Toronto Downtown; Toronto Metropolitan University – International Living/Learning Centre (ILC); Toronto Metropolitan University – Pitman Hall (PIT). The student residence offers use links supplied to registered, fully paid students; their listing does not establish individual contractual block sizes. Exact group rule: "10+ rooms per night qualify as Group Bookings." Questions go to isprs2026-registration@icsevents.com. No open hotel RFP or current inventory is established; Radisson Blu is not listed.
findings.organizationStructure: This is an international association scientific congress, not a corporate incentive programme. ISPRS is the international society/event series owner; CRSS-SCT was the Canadian host and co-located its 47th Canadian Symposium on Remote Sensing. ICS is the commercial Congress Secretariat and official housing bureau, distinct from the association and the MTCC venue. The original corporate_meetings_incentives segment should not be carried forward without correction.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The 2026 accommodation page establishes an incumbent official housing channel and financial incentives to use it. Delta Hotels Toronto and DoubleTree by Hilton Toronto Downtown appear with sold-out ribbon image labels in the retained page. These are historical page markers, not proof of whole-hotel sell-outs, unmet overflow, contracted room totals, or business available now. Three student accommodation alternatives were also listed. The post-event host report identifies the gala dinner at the Art Gallery of Ontario, so it should not be pitched as an unplaced 2026 hotel function.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Do not quote a 2026 block or qualify this as upcoming Toronto business. Make one targeted relationship approach to Derek Lichti and ICS via the published event contact route: ask who now manages Canadian meeting/housing sourcing, whether any independently scheduled Toronto workshops or executive meetings exist, and whether the hotel can be considered for a future appropriately sized official block. Use Ahmed Shaker for association routing if needed. Only open a new sales opportunity after an actual future Toronto date, buyer, sourcing pathway and room requirement are verified. Do not divert delegates from historical contracted channels.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Closed by timing: actual activity was 4–11 July 2026 and the official site says the Congress has ended. As of 15 November 2026, this edition cannot create future pickup within the requested horizon. Its housing was bureau-managed and committed to an official accommodation programme. Historical group-booking instructions do not imply a live sales lead.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Relationship-only inference: retain ICS and Canadian host leadership as potential routes to a separately verified future Toronto meeting or a later Toronto bid. Sydney 2029 and Incheon 2030 create no direct lodging demand for this Toronto hotel. Annual Congresses from 2029 do not support forecasting a Toronto return. No Toronto capture date, open block, overflow requirement, or room-night forecast is supportable.
